$comment: The things we scan for. One entry per case study / portfolio item. Keep the slug stable — inventory.json keys off it. `queries` are the literal search strings; write them the way a journalist would name the thing, not the way we name it internally, and include the partner brand, the venue and the year, because that is what actually appears in a headline. `aliases` catch the names the press uses that we do not.
